problems: Day 27 (Bernard Shaw, Back to Methuselah, Act I): the card runs two Serpent speeches together. ‘You see things; and you say “Why?” But I dream things that never were; and I say “Why not?”’ and ‘I made the word dead to describe my old skin that I cast when I am renewed. I call that renewal being born.’ are not contiguous in Act I, and the locator names only the act, so a reader cannot check the join. Either drop the second half, or give the exact page of a named edition and add a hedging note; as it stands it is an unmarked splice and the card carries no note.

The month is still under the cap of 16, so no line needs to change, but the figure should be corrected before the month lands.
